name: Attio
description: Access your entire CRM directly from Claude. Look up contacts and companies, find decision makers, and discover email addresses. Log notes from calls and meetings, track engagement history, and create follow-up tasks with deadlines. Search and filter your pipeline by stage, funding round, role, or location. Tap into meeting intelligence—search call recordings, access transcripts, and surface key insights. Make Attio a seamless part of your AI workflow, so you can manage relationships and close deals faster without switching tools.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Attio to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Attio to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.attio.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Attio MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Attio lists 23 MCP tools, including create-note, create-record, create-task, get-call-recording, get-email-content, get-note-body, get-records-by-ids, list-attribute-definitions, list-records, list-workspace-members, list-workspace-teams, and search-call-recordings-by-metadata.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Attio?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Attio in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Attio requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Attio is developed by Attio. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
